ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Status, CardRarity.Status, TargetType.None)` (Beckon.cs:19-22) == cost 1 / STATUS / STATUS / NONE. OnTurnEndInHand.rationale: `CreatureCmd.Damage(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.HpLoss.BaseValue, Unblockable | Unpowered | Move, this)` (Beckon.cs:26) == `DamageCmd.deal(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, 6, card=self, props=DamageProps.CARD_HP_LOSS)`; `CARD_HP_LOSS` is exactly that prop triple (valueprops.py:38). No dealer on either side. Unlike Bad Luck there is no Cmd.Wait, so the two bodies are step-for-step identical.

OnPlay.rationale: Beckon.cs declares no OnPlay, so playing it does nothing; the sim's abstract method is a `pass`. Because Beckon IS playable this is a reachable no-op on both sides, not dead code.

guards.what: the sim adds `is_unpowered = True` (beckon.py:26), which has no counterpart in Beckon.cs
guards.rationale: The verdict holds but NOT for the reason first recorded: `is_unpowered` has NINE readers in the sim, not one. Besides `DamageCmd.deal`'s prop inference (cmds.py:46-50) it is read at powers.py (stale numbered list after a reorg; not individually re-pinned this pass, content re-confirmed to still gate on the same flag), relics/the_boot.py:37, previews.py:157 and cards/thrash.py:44. Each is independently unreachable for Beckon, checked by execution rather than assumed: (1) cmds.py:46-50 is the `props is None` branch and Beckon's only damage passes `CARD_HP_LOSS` explicitly (beckon.py:39), so the inference never runs. (2) powers.py:217 (StrengthPower.modify_damage_additive), and a family of modify_damage_multiplicative implementers (VulnerablePower/WeakPower/ColossusPower/etc -- old citations 1260/1385 stale after a powers.py reorg, not individually re-pinned this pass) are dispatched only from inside `DamageCmd.deal`'s `if is_powered_attack(props):` gate (cmds.py:56-58); `CARD_HP_LOSS` is `UNBLOCKABLE | UNPOWERED | MOVE` (valueprops.py:38) and `is_powered_attack` is `MOVE in props and UNPOWERED not in props` (valueprops.py:47-49), which evaluates False -- the whole modifier dispatch is skipped, so those three never see Beckon. (3) powers.py:2434 (VigorPower.before_attack) and another before_attack implementer (old citation 3965 stale after a powers.py reorg, not individually re-pinned this pass) fire only from combat.py:476-479, which brackets the play in `is_attack = card.card_type == CardType.ATTACK`; Beckon is a STATUS, and its damage is not a card play at all -- it comes from `on_turn_end_in_hand`. (4) relics/the_boot.py:37 is guarded by `if dealer is not self.player or target is self.player: return amount` (the_boot.py:34-35) and Beckon deals with NO dealer to the player, so both disjuncts hold and it returns before the read. (5) previews.py:157 is preceded by `base = card_base_damage(...); if base is None: return None` (previews.py:154-156); Beckon declares no `_damage` and no `calc_damage`, so `base_damage` returns its `getattr(self, "_damage", None)` default of None (cards/base.py:191-196) and the function returns before line 157. (6) cards/thrash.py:44 runs only on a victim drawn from `[c for c in ctx.player.hand if c.card_type == CT.ATTACK]` (thrash.py:58); Beckon is a STATUS and can never be that victim. So the flag is inert on this card at every site, and adding it to a card Beckon.cs does not mark is harmless -- but it is inert by nine separate unreachability facts, not because nothing reads it.
